content: 1. Dronabinol is metabolized by the hepatic enzyme CYP2C9. Carbamazepine decreases the levels or effects of dronabinol by inducing CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 2. Carbamazepine can also increase the levels or effects of dronabinol by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Dronabinol is a substrate of CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor closely. 3. Cefotetan increases the toxicity of dronabinol by inhibiting aldehyde dehydrogenase. This combination is contraindicated. Discontinue cefotetan at least 14 days before starting dronabinol solution, and do not administer cefotetan within 7 days of completing dronabinol treatment. 4. Cenobamate and dronabinol can mutually enhance sedative effects. Cenobamate decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Adjust therapy and monitor closely. Increase the dose of CYP3A4 substrates as needed when coadministered with cenobamate. 5. Ceritinib increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 6. Chloramphenicol increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 7. Clarithromycin increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 8. Clobazam and dronabinol may increase sedation or respiratory depression when used together. Use caution and monitor closely. 9. Clonidine and dronabinol may increase each other’s toxicity through pharmacodynamic synergism, enhancing CNS depressant effects. Use caution and monitor closely. 10. Cobicistat increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 11. Conivaptan increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 12. Cyclophosphamide increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. Monitor closely. 13. Dronabinol increases cyclosporine levels by competing for plasma protein binding. Adjust therapy and monitor closely. Dronabinol is highly protein-bound and may displace other protein-bound drugs, potentially increasing their free fraction. Exercise caution with drugs that have a narrow therapeutic index. 14. Dabrafenib decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 15. Danazol increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 16. Dronabinol and daridorexant both increase sedation. Coadministration increases the risk of CNS depression, which may impair psychomotor performance and cause daytime impairment. Adjust therapy and monitor closely. 17. Darunavir increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 18. Dexamethasone decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 19. Difelikefalin and dronabinol both increase sedation. Use caution and monitor closely. 20. Disulfiram increases dronabinol toxicity by inhibiting aldehyde dehydrogenase. This combination is contraindicated. Discontinue disulfiram at least 14 days before starting dronabinol solution, and do not administer disulfiram within 7 days of completing dronabinol treatment. 21. Drospirenone increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. Monitor closely. 22. Efavirenz increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 23. Elagolix decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Adjust therapy and monitor closely. Elagolix is a weak-to-moderate CYP3A4 inducer. 24. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 25. Enzalutamide decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 26. Eslicarbazepine acetate decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 27. Etravirine decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 28. Fedratinib increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Adjust the dose of CYP3A4 substrates as necessary. Use caution and monitor closely. 29. Fexinidazole increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 30. Fluconazole increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP2C9 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 31. Fluorouracil increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP2C9 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 32. Flurbiprofen increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP2C9 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 33. Fosamprenavir increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 34. Fosphenytoin decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 35. Gemfibrozil increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP2C9 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 36. Grapefruit increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 37. Ibuprofen increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP2C9 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 38. Use caution and monitor closely. 40. Imatinib increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 41. Use caution and monitor closely. 43. Isoniazid increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 44. Istradefylline increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Consider dose reduction of sensitive CYP3A4 substrates. Use caution and monitor closely. 45. Itraconazole increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 46. Ivosidenib decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP2C9 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 47. Ketoconazole increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 48. Larotrectinib increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. Monitor closely. 49. Use caution and monitor closely. 54. Lumacaftor/ivacaftor decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 55. Lurasidone and dronabinol may increase each other’s toxicity, potentially enhancing CNS depressant effects. Use caution and monitor closely. 56. Mefenamic acid increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP2C9 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 57. Methylphenidate increases dronabinol levels through pharmacodynamic synergism, increasing the risk of acute hypertensive episodes. Use caution and monitor closely. 58. Metoclopramide intranasal and dronabinol may increase each other’s effects. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 59. Metronidazole increases dronabinol toxicity by inhibiting aldehyde dehydrogenase. This combination is contraindicated. Discontinue metronidazole at least 14 days before starting dronabinol solution, and do not administer metronidazole within 7 days of completing dronabinol treatment. 60. Midazolam intranasal and dronabinol may increase each other’s levels through pharmacodynamic synergism. Adjust therapy and monitor closely. 61. Mifepristone increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 62. Mitotane decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 63. Nafcillin decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 64. Naltrexone may enhance the therapeutic effects of cannabinoids, including dronabinol. Use caution and monitor closely. 65. Nefazodone increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 66. Nelfinavir increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP2E1 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug.
